title: Error Taxonomy and Structured JSON Logging with Request Context
instructions: Implement the error taxonomy in `errors.py` (`GatewayError`, `UpstreamError` and its retryable/non-retryable subclasses, plus `from_status` that preserves `__cause__`) and the JSON logging in `jsonlog.py` (`request_id` ContextVar helpers, `ContextFilter`, `JsonFormatter`, `configure` via `dictConfig`). Every record must carry the request id of the task that logged it.

evidence.label: Maps 429, 408/504, other 5xx and 4xx statuses to the right error class and retryable flag
Errors form the expected hierarchy and expose status and retry_after
from_status keeps retry_after and chains the given cause
Statuses below 400 raise ValueError("not an error status: <n>")
Logs one sorted-key JSON object per line with level, logger, msg, request_id and extras
bind_request_id restores the previous value, even when the block raises
Exception records include exc_type, exc and the cause (only when one exists)
configure honours the level, does not stack handlers and keeps existing loggers enabled
Concurrent asyncio tasks each log their own request id
